definition: Assenting to the existence of the relevant personal God. Nonbelief includes doubt and suspension, as well as outright denial. Belief is distinct from knowledge, certainty, felt presence, accepting a relationship, and voluntary control over belief. Belief may be false in a non-theistic interpretation.
